name: Cala
description: Cala pre-processes the world's public information and serves it as structured data for AI agents. Query any real-world entity — companies, people, investors, founders, executives, funding rounds, acquisitions, industries, laws, regulations, countries, products, events, awards, financial metrics — and get typed, sourced JSON back instead of web pages to scrape.
longDescription:
Ships **1 MCP server**, `cala`.

Installs with `claude plugin install cala@claude-community` from `cala-ai/cala-claude-plugin`.

A Claude Code plugin that connects Claude to Cala, the knowledge layer for AI agents.

Cala pre-processes the world's public information and serves it as structured data for AI agents. Query any real-world entity — companies, people, investors, founders, executives, funding rounds, acquisitions, industries, laws, regulations, countries, products, events, awards, financial metrics — and get typed, sourced JSON back instead of web pages to scrape.
